description: Security-test a desktop thick client end to end: map its trust boundaries, then work the local attack surface (config files, credential storage, IPC, update channel) and the network surface (proxying, certificate pinning, hidden APIs). Load for a C/S desktop app in scope — Electron, Qt, .NET WinForms/WPF, or native — an installer to audit, local config/credential storage to assess, named pipes or loopback IPC, an auto-update channel, or a client that hides admin-only API calls.
